content.title: CACI Q3 Deep Dive: Technology Mix, Bookings Momentum, and National Security Demand Fuel Results
content.summary: Defense, intelligence, and IT solutions provider CACI International (NYSE:CACI) reported Q3 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 11.2% year on year to $2.29 billion.
